name: IoT-Based Smart Irrigation System
desc: Academic ECE project using Arduino, soil-moisture sensing and relay control to automate irrigation based on soil conditions. Designed to reduce water wastage and demonstrate practical IoT and embedded-system concepts.

name: RFID-Based Smart Attendance System
desc: Academic embedded-systems project using RFID technology and a microcontroller to identify users and record attendance. Built to demonstrate RFID communication, sensor interfacing and basic data handling.
